title.zh: 赌场管制（最高博彩区面积）命令 2026
title.vi: Lệnh Kiểm soát sòng bạc (Diện tích Trò chơi Tối đa) 2026
title.th: คำสั่งการควบคุมคาสิโน (พื้นที่เล่นเกมสูงสุด) 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Casino Control (Maximum Gaming Area) Order 2026 and comes into operation on 21 September 2026.

3. The aggregate of all the gaming areas within any casino premises must not exceed —
(a)for the casino operated by Marina Bay Sands Pte. Ltd. — 16,000 square metres; and
(b)for the casino operated by Resorts World at Sentosa Pte. Ltd. — 15,000 square metres.
